<h1 id="一centos-stream-9centos-stream-10概述">一.<strong>CentOS Stream 9</strong>/<strong>CentOS Stream 10</strong>概述</h1>
<p>CentOS Stream 是 Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 的上游开发分支，采用“滚动更新”模式。这意味着它介于 Fedora 和 RHEL 之间，让你能提前看到 RHEL 未来的功能。</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>特性</th>
<th>CentOS Stream 9</th>
<th>CentOS Stream 10</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>对应 RHEL 版本</td>
<td>RHEL 9 系列</td>
<td>RHEL 10 系列</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>内核版本</td>
<td>Kernel 5.14</td>
<td>Kernel 6.12+ (显著更新)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Python 默认版本</td>
<td>Python 3.9</td>
<td>Python 3.12 (性能更强)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>编译器工具链</td>
<td>GCC 11</td>
<td>GCC 14 (支持新语言特性)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>系统架构</td>
<td>传统 YUM/DNF</td>
<td>引入 System Wide Image (SWI) 和 Bootable Container 概念</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>生命周期</td>
<td>维护至 2027 年 (全支持) / 2032 年 (维护支持)</td>
<td>预计维护至 2030 年代初</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>代号</td>
<td>无特定代号</td>
<td>Coughlan</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h1 id="二系统环境">二.系统环境</h1>
<table>
<thead>

<th>内核版本</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>CentOS Stream release 10 (Coughlan)</td>
<td>6.12.0-212.el10.x86_64</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>CentOS Stream release 9</td>
<td>5.14.0-687.el9.x86_64</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h1 id="三centos-stream-9centos-stream-10配置静态ip">三.<strong>CentOS Stream 9</strong>/<strong>CentOS Stream 10</strong>配置静态IP</h1>
<h2 id="31-networkmanager配置静态ip">3.1 NetworkManager配置静态IP</h2>
<p>CentOS Stream 9/CentOS Stream 10的网络配置文件不再使用/etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ifcfg-eth0，network服务已经弃用，默认使用NetworkManager管理网络，配置文件位于<code>/etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/</code>目录下。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost ~]# cd /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/
[root@localhost system-connections]# ls
ens160.nmconnection
</code></pre>
<p>修改配置文件，指定机器静态IP为192.168.0.132。</p>
<ul>
<li><code>address1</code>：指定静态IP地址和子网掩码（CIDR格式）；</li>
<li><code>dns</code>：指定DNS服务器列表，多个地址用分号分隔，建议使用国内的DNS服务器地址，这样更快，比如：223.5.5.5;223.6.6.6；</li>
<li><code>method</code>：method=manual表示强制使用手动配置模式，method=auto表示启用 DHCP (动态主机配置协议)，动态获取IP；</li>
<li><code>gateway</code>：指定服务器网关。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost system-connections]# vim ens160.nmconnection

[root@localhost system-connections]# cat ens160.nmconnection 
[connection]
#网卡名称
id=ens160
#系统内部用来唯一标识这个连接配置。即使你把 id 改名了，UUID 也不会变，确保系统不会搞混。
uuid=89fcf374-9ca1-30b1-b1dd-ed124953574c
#表明这是一个标准的以太网（有线网卡）连接。
type=ethernet
#自动连接优先级。这是一个非常低的优先级（范围通常是 -999 到 999）。
autoconnect-priority=-999
#绑定的物理网卡名称。
interface-name=ens160
timestamp=1775042953

[ethernet]
#双工模式设置为半双工。半双工意味着同一时间只能发数据或收数据，不能同时进行，且容易发生冲突。这会严重限制网卡性能。除非连接的是非
#常古老的集线器（Hub）或特殊工业设备，否则建议改为 duplex=full 或直接删除此行让网卡自动协商。
duplex=half
#强制网卡速率锁定为 10000 Mbps (10 Gbps)。
speed=10000

[ipv4]
address1=192.168.0.132/24
dns=223.5.5.5;223.6.6.6;119.29.29.29;182.254.116.116;
gateway=192.168.0.2
method=manual

[ipv6]
#地址生成模式。使用 EUI-64 算法基于网卡的 MAC 地址生成 IPv6 地址的后 64 位。这种方式生成的地址是固定的，便于追踪，但隐私性不如#默认的“稳定隐私地址”。
addr-gen-mode=eui64
#自动模式。
method=auto

[proxy]
</code></pre>
<p>重载配置文件并重启。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost system-connections]# systemctl restart NetworkManager

[root@localhost system-connections]# systemctl status NetworkManager
● NetworkManager.service - Network Manager
     Loaded: loaded (/usr/lib/systemd/system/NetworkManager.service; enabled; preset: enabled)
     Active: active (running) since Thu 2026-04-02 22:06:20 CST; 8s ago
 Invocation: ed6964f8bf7d4a7aa7301b361329c36a
       Docs: man:NetworkManager(8)
   Main PID: 1841 (NetworkManager)
      Tasks: 5 (limit: 23984)
     Memory: 3.4M (peak: 4.3M)
        CPU: 52ms
     CGroup: /system.slice/NetworkManager.service
             └─1841 /usr/sbin/NetworkManager --no-daemon

4月 02 22:06:20 localhost.localdomain NetworkManager[1841]: &lt;info&gt;  [1775138780.7000] device (ens1&gt;
4月 02 22:06:20 localhost.localdomain NetworkManager[1841]: &lt;info&gt;  [1775138780.7015] policy: set &gt;
4月 02 22:06:20 localhost.localdomain NetworkManager[1841]: &lt;info&gt;  [1775138780.7054] device (ens1&gt;
4月 02 22:06:20 localhost.localdomain NetworkManager[1841]: &lt;info&gt;  [1775138780.7071] device (ens1&gt;
4月 02 22:06:20 localhost.localdomain NetworkManager[1841]: &lt;info&gt;  [1775138780.7072] device (ens1&gt;
4月 02 22:06:20 localhost.localdomain NetworkManager[1841]: &lt;info&gt;  [1775138780.7075] manager: Net&gt;
4月 02 22:06:20 localhost.localdomain NetworkManager[1841]: &lt;info&gt;  [1775138780.7076] device (ens1&gt;
4月 02 22:06:20 localhost.localdomain NetworkManager[1841]: &lt;info&gt;  [1775138780.7079] manager: Net&gt;
4月 02 22:06:20 localhost.localdomain NetworkManager[1841]: &lt;info&gt;  [1775138780.7080] manager: sta&gt;
4月 02 22:06:20 localhost.localdomain NetworkManager[1841]: &lt;info&gt;  [1775138780.8850] policy: set-&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>在/etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/ens160.nmconnection里配置了DNS之后，/etc/resolv.conf 里的DNS也会变化。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost system-connections]# cat /etc/resolv.conf 
# Generated by NetworkManager
nameserver 223.5.5.5
nameserver 223.6.6.6
nameserver 119.29.29.29
# NOTE: the libc resolver may not support more than 3 nameservers.
# The nameservers listed below may not be recognized.
nameserver 182.254.116.116
</code></pre>
<p>查看IP发现ip配置成功，也能上网了。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost system-connections]# ip a
1: lo: &lt;LOOPBACK,UP,LOWER_UP&gt; mtu 65536 qdisc noqueue state UNKNOWN group default qlen 1000
    link/loopback 00:00:00:00:00:00 brd 00:00:00:00:00:00
    inet 127.0.0.1/8 scope host lo
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever
    inet6 ::1/128 scope host noprefixroute 
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever
2: ens160: &lt;BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP&gt; mtu 1500 qdisc mq state UP group default qlen 1000
    link/ether 00:0c:29:de:bf:87 brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
    altname enp3s0
    altname enx000c29debf87
    inet 192.168.0.132/24 brd 192.168.0.255 scope global noprefixroute ens160
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever
    inet6 fe80::20c:29ff:fede:bf87/64 scope link noprefixroute 
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever
       
#查看路由       
[root@localhost system-connections]# ip r
default via 192.168.0.2 dev ens160 proto static metric 100 
192.168.0.0/24 dev ens160 proto kernel scope link src 192.168.0.132 metric 100 

#可以上网
[root@localhost system-connections]# ping qq.com
PING qq.com (113.108.81.189) 56(84) 字节的数据。
64 字节，来自 113.108.81.189: icmp_seq=1 ttl=128 时间=61.3 毫秒
64 字节，来自 113.108.81.189: icmp_seq=2 ttl=128 时间=71.2 毫秒
64 字节，来自 113.108.81.189: icmp_seq=3 ttl=128 时间=69.3 毫秒
64 字节，来自 113.108.81.189: icmp_seq=4 ttl=128 时间=71.7 毫秒
64 字节，来自 113.108.81.189: icmp_seq=5 ttl=128 时间=69.7 毫秒
64 字节，来自 113.108.81.189: icmp_seq=6 ttl=128 时间=68.2 毫秒
^C
--- qq.com ping 统计 ---

rtt min/avg/max/mdev = 61.309/68.572/71.737/3.449 ms
</code></pre>
<h2 id="32-nmcli配置静态ip">3.2 nmcli配置静态IP</h2>
<p>在 CentOS Stream 9 中，网络管理已经完全转向由 <strong>NetworkManager</strong> 主导。<code>nmcli</code>（NetworkManager Command Line Interface）是其核心的命令行工具。相比传统的 <code>ifcfg</code> 脚本或 <code>ip addr</code> 命令，<code>nmcli</code> 的优势在于它的配置是<strong>持久化</strong>的（重启不失效），且能实时反映 NetworkManager 的状态。</p>
<p><strong>nmcli常用命令</strong>：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>操作类型</th>
<th>命令示例</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>查看状态</td>
<td><code>nmcli general status</code></td>
<td>查看 NetworkManager 整体运行状态</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>查看设备</td>
<td><code>nmcli device status</code></td>
<td>查看所有网卡及其连接状态</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>查看连接</td>
<td><code>nmcli connection show</code></td>
<td>列出所有已保存的连接配置文件</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>启用连接</td>
<td><code>nmcli connection up &lt;ID&gt;</code></td>
<td>激活指定的连接配置</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>禁用连接</td>
<td><code>nmcli connection down &lt;ID&gt;</code></td>
<td>断开指定的连接</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>重新加载</td>
<td><code>nmcli connection reload</code></td>
<td>修改配置文件后，重新加载到内存</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>修改网卡为静态IP，IP地址配置为192.168.0.132。</p>
<ul>
<li><code>ipv4.addresses</code>：静态IP地址（CIDR格式）；</li>
<li><code>ipv4.gateway</code>：默认网关；</li>
<li><code>ipv4.dns</code>：DNS服务器列表（逗号分隔）。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost ~]# nmcli connection modify "ens33" \
  ipv4.addresses "192.168.0.132/24" \
  ipv4.gateway "192.168.0.2" \
  ipv4.dns "223.5.5.5,8.8.8.8" \
  ipv4.method manual
</code></pre>
<p>激活配置。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost ~]# nmcli connection down ens33 &amp;&amp; sudo nmcli connection up ens33
</code></pre>
<p>查看具体连接详情。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost ~]# nmcli connection show ens33
</code></pre>
<h1 id="四centos9centos10配置dnfyum源">四.centos9/centos10配置dnf/yum源</h1>
<h2 id="41-dnf概述">4.1 dnf概述</h2>
<p><strong>dnf (Dandified YUM)</strong> 是基于 RPM 的 Linux 发行版的<strong>新一代软件包管理器</strong>，专为 Fedora、RHEL 8+ 及 CentOS Stream 9/10 等系统设计，作为 <strong>yum 的直接替代品</strong>，dnf 解决了 yum 的性能瓶颈和功能限制，同时保持了类似的命令语法，在 CentOS Stream 9/10 中，<strong>yum 命令实际上是指向 dnf 的符号链接</strong>，执行 yum 时实际调用的是 dnf 功能。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost ~]# ll -h /usr/bin/yum 
lrwxrwxrwx. 1 root root 5  2月16日 08:00 /usr/bin/yum -&gt; dnf-3
[root@localhost ~]# ll -h /usr/bin/dnf
lrwxrwxrwx. 1 root root 5  2月16日 08:00 /usr/bin/dnf -&gt; dnf-3
</code></pre>
<h2 id="42-dnf常用命令">4.2 dnf常用命令</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>命令类型</th>
<th>命令示例</th>
<th>功能描述</th>
<th>使用场景</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>基础安装</td>
<td><code>sudo dnf install &lt;package&gt;</code></td>
<td>安装指定软件包</td>
<td>安装新软件</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf install &lt;package1&gt; &lt;package2&gt;</code></td>
<td>同时安装多个软件包</td>
<td>批量安装</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf install -y &lt;package&gt;</code></td>
<td>自动确认安装（无需交互）</td>
<td>自动化脚本</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>软件包管理</td>
<td><code>sudo dnf remove &lt;package&gt;</code></td>
<td>卸载软件包</td>
<td>移除不需要的软件</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf update</code></td>
<td>更新所有已安装的软件包</td>
<td>系统升级</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf update &lt;package&gt;</code></td>
<td>更新特定软件包</td>
<td>选择性更新</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf autoremove</code></td>
<td>自动清理不再需要的依赖</td>
<td>系统精简</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>查询与搜索</td>
<td><code>dnf search &lt;keyword&gt;</code></td>
<td>搜索软件包</td>
<td>查找可用软件</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>dnf info &lt;package&gt;</code></td>
<td>查看软件包详细信息</td>
<td>了解软件详情</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>dnf provides /path/to/file</code></td>
<td>查找提供特定文件的软件包</td>
<td>问题排查</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>dnf list installed</code></td>
<td>列出所有已安装软件包</td>
<td>系统审计</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>仓库管理</td>
<td><code>dnf repolist</code></td>
<td>列出所有启用的仓库</td>
<td>检查源配置</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>dnf repolist --verbose</code></td>
<td>显示仓库详细信息（URL、状态等）</td>
<td>源问题排查</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf config-manager --enable &lt;repo&gt;</code></td>
<td>启用指定仓库</td>
<td>添加新源</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf config-manager --disable &lt;repo&gt;</code></td>
<td>禁用指定仓库</td>
<td>临时移除源</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>缓存管理</td>
<td><code>sudo dnf clean all</code></td>
<td>清除所有缓存（元数据和软件包）</td>
<td>解决缓存问题</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf makecache</code></td>
<td>重建缓存</td>
<td>源更新后</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf clean packages</code></td>
<td>仅删除已下载的.rpm文件</td>
<td>释放磁盘空间</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>事务与历史</td>
<td><code>dnf history</code></td>
<td>查看所有操作记录</td>
<td>审计系统变更</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>dnf history info 5</code></td>
<td>查看第5条记录的详细变更</td>
<td>问题分析</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf history undo 5</code></td>
<td>撤销第5条操作</td>
<td>系统回滚</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>模块化功能</td>
<td><code>dnf module list</code></td>
<td>列出可用的模块</td>
<td>查看多版本软件</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf module enable php:8.0</code></td>
<td>启用特定模块</td>
<td>使用指定版本</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf module install php</code></td>
<td>安装模块化软件</td>
<td>安装多版本软件</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>高级功能</td>
<td><code>dnf download &lt;package&gt; --resolve</code></td>
<td>下载软件包及其依赖（不安装）</td>
<td>离线安装准备</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf install ./*.rpm</code></td>
<td>安装本地下载的RPM包</td>
<td>离线安装</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><code>sudo dnf repair</code></td>
<td>尝试自动修复系统</td>
<td>解决软件包损坏问题</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="43-配置dnfyum源">4.3 配置dnf/yum源</h2>
<p>备份原先的repo文件。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost ~]# cd /etc/yum.repos.d/

[root@localhost yum.repos.d]# ls
centos-addons.repo  centos.repo

[root@localhost yum.repos.d]# mkdir bak

[root@localhost yum.repos.d]# mv *.repo bak/

[root@localhost yum.repos.d]# ls
bak
</code></pre>
<p>配置阿里云的yum源:ali-centos.repo 。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost yum.repos.d]# cat ali-centos.repo 
[baseos]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - BaseOS
baseurl=https://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/BaseOS/$basearch/os/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
countme=1
enabled=1

[baseos-debug]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - BaseOS - Debug
baseurl=https://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/BaseOS/$basearch/debug/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[baseos-source]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - BaseOS - Source
baseurl=https://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/BaseOS/source/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[appstream]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - AppStream
baseurl=https://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/AppStream/$basearch/os/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
countme=1
enabled=1

[appstream-debug]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - AppStream - Debug
baseurl=https://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/AppStream/$basearch/debug/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[appstream-source]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - AppStream - Source
baseurl=https://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/AppStream/$basearch/debug/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[crb]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - CRB
baseurl=https://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/CRB/$basearch/os/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
countme=1
enabled=1

[crb-debug]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - CRB - Debug
baseurl=https://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/CRB/$basearch/debug/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[crb-source]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - CRB - Source
baseurl=https://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/CRB/source/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0
</code></pre>
<p>配置阿里云的yum源:ali-addons.repo 。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost yum.repos.d]# cat ali-addons.repo 
[highavailability]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - HighAvailability
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/HighAvailability/$basearch/os/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
countme=1
enabled=0

[highavailability-debug]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - HighAvailability - Debug
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/HighAvailability/$basearch/debug/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[highavailability-source]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - HighAvailability - Source
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/HighAvailability/source/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[nfv]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - NFV
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/NFV/$basearch/os/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
countme=1
enabled=0

[nfv-debug]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - NFV - Debug
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/NFV/$basearch/debug/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[nfv-source]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - NFV - Source
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/NFV/source/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[rt]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - RT
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/RT/$basearch/os/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
countme=1
enabled=0

[rt-debug]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - RT - Debug
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/RT/$basearch/debug/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[rt-source]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - RT - Source
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/RT/source/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[resilientstorage]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - ResilientStorage
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/ResilientStorage/$basearch/os/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
countme=1
enabled=0

[resilientstorage-debug]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - ResilientStorage - Debug
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/ResilientStorage/$basearch/debug/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[resilientstorage-source]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - ResilientStorage - Source
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/$stream/ResilientStorage/source/tree/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-centosofficial
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0

[extras-common]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - Extras packages
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/SIGs/$stream/extras/$basearch/extras-common/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-CentOS-SIG-Extras-SHA512
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
countme=1
enabled=1

[extras-common-source]
name=CentOS Stream $releasever - Extras packages - Source
baseurl=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos-stream/SIGs/$stream/extras/source/extras-common/
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-CentOS-SIG-Extras-SHA512
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=0
metadata_expire=6h
enabled=0
</code></pre>
<p>安装EPEL 仓库（提供额外软件包）。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost yum.repos.d]# dnf install epel-release

[root@localhost yum.repos.d]# pwd
/etc/yum.repos.d
[root@localhost yum.repos.d]# ls
ali-addons.repo  ali-centos.repo  bak  epel.repo  epel-testing.repo
</code></pre>
<p>清除所有缓存（元数据和软件包）。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost ~]# dnf clean all
</code></pre>
<p>重建缓存以及更新所有已安装的软件包</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@localhost ~]# dnf makecache
[root@localhost ~]# dnf update
</code></pre>
<p>自此yum源配置完毕。</p>
